AIVA pricing

Short answer: AIVA has a free plan, and paid plans start at €11 a month (billed annually). Free tier: non-commercial, credit AIVA, 3 downloads/mo. We checked every plan below on the official pricing page on Oct 18, 2026.

Every plan

Free€0/mo€0/moNon-commercial; credit AIVA; 3 downloads/mo; tracks up to 3 min

"n/a" means that billing option isn't listed. Prices exclude tax. Source: official pricing page.
